# The unwrap/expect ceiling per workspace package (GH #115).
# Format: <package> <max clippy::unwrap_used + clippy::expect_used hits>
# Measured by .github/gates/unwrap_budget.py over the default targets
# (lib + bins) -- test modules and tests/ are out of scope by design.
# A number may only ever go DOWN. Re-pin with `unwrap_budget.py --write`
# and say in the commit why the number moved.
#
# meclaw-cells 71 -> 72 (wave voice-cell, 2026-09-05): one `expect` on the
# `cell.db` open inside a long-running factory's build closure. The closure is
# the `RespawnFn`, whose signature returns the spawn tuple and has nowhere to
# put a failure, and `build_long_running_task` needs a `DbConn`, which needs a
# `rusqlite::Connection` -- there is no value to fall back to. `web`, `timer`,
# `mcp` and `proxy` each carry the same call site for the same reason; a new
# cell type of that kind costs exactly one. The other two the `voice` cell would
# have taken were paid off instead of pinned: `split_io` is typed
# `Option<VoiceIo>` rather than unwrapped, and the session lookup in `handle`
# uses a let-else.

meclaw 0
meclaw-api 2
meclaw-cells 72
meclaw-cli 0
meclaw-colony 64
meclaw-core 3
meclaw-surface 0
meclaw-testing 45
